decisionContext: The owner explicitly approved both 24-row North Node batches, later directly instructed an updated Sun sextile North Node passage, and then authorized shipping the 48 approved North Node passages into the governed Calendar exact-aspect corpus by replying "yes please continue".
summary: Missing what was familiar can make returning look more right than it actually is.
body: Missing what was familiar can make returning look more right than it actually is. When the Moon opposes the North Node, an old home, family routine, relationship pattern, or former schedule can feel emotionally convincing because your body already knows how to function inside it. That pull may contain useful information, especially if the newer plan has left out rest, belonging, predictability, or care that you still need. Bring the need forward before you bring the whole old arrangement back.
